#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string str;
    cin >> str;
    int toPrint = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < (int)str.length()) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < (int)str.length() && str[j] == str[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        int runLength = j - i;
        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            toPrint++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    cout << toPrint << endl;
    return 0;
}
